definition.//: Decision D7 (eval/study/README.md decision log), approved by the founder 2026-11-06 and recorded before any held-out census. D5 (tier-d5.json) narrowed by rule kind and language. TypeScript/JavaScript: the default tier admits only call wrappers (wrapped_by:call) and layering (avoids:import); wrapped_by:decorator, wrapped_by:extends and wrapped_by:jsx move to the suggestion tier. Python: no rule kind is in the default tier; Python advises only and every Python proposal is suggestion tier. D5's conditions still apply on top of the rule kind: every symbol the rule names is defined in the repository (default.target "in_repo": no pkg:, global# or unresolved: target; lib.mjs namesPackage, drift_mine::tier::names_package) and the role has >= default.min_members members. The language of a proposal is read conservatively (lib.mjs proposalLanguage, drift_mine::tier::convention_language): py when any member of its role is Python (conventions.yaml evidence.python_members) or its example path is (.py/.pyi files and Python package manifests), ts otherwise. Role members are counted as the role's size (evidence.role_members when set, else total; exempt members count). DEFAULT tier = language in default.languages AND structured rule kind (lib.mjs ruleKind) in default.rule_kinds AND the rule names no symbol from outside the repository AND its role has >= default.min_members members. SUGGESTION tier = every other shown proposal. The not-wrong rate is reported over all shown proposals, both tiers. Release gate unchanged: a language's default tier ships as advise until it measures >= 95% default-tier accept under rubric v3, judged per D1, on a primary held-out run.

default.//: TypeScript/JavaScript call wrappers and layering (import avoidance), each only when every symbol it names is defined in the repository, in roles of 15 or more members

suggestion.//: D5's suggestion kinds, plus decorators, base classes and JSX layout wrappers (D7); every Python proposal (languages); and default-tier kinds whose rule names a package, built-in or unresolved symbol, or whose role is small

target.criterion: met when the point estimate, per language, is ≥ 95% (decision D1, 2026-11-05)
